items.name: longsword
items.text: an heirloom longsword, fuller catching a line of light, edge nicked by use, leather grip burnished dark by hands

items.name: katana
items.text: a lacquer-sheathed katana carried low, silk wrap crossing the ray-skin hilt, fittings worn bright at the edges

items.name: wizard-staff
items.text: a gnarled staff crowned with a dim glowing crystal, light seeping between the wooden fingers that grip the stone

items.name: kite-shield
items.text: a dented kite shield, heraldry faded to ghost colors, rim split and the iron boss burnished by blows

items.name: storm-lantern
items.text: a brass storm lantern casting warm swaying light, soot feathering up the glass chimney

items.name: ancient-tome
items.text: a strap-bound ancient tome, brass clasps green at the hinges, fore-edge gilding cracked with use

items.name: energy-blade
items.text: a humming energy blade, its colored light modeling the hands and face from below, drifting dust igniting bright wherever it crosses the glow

items.name: recurve-bow
items.text: a carved recurve bow, horn-and-sinew limbs glossy with wax, a full quiver riding the hip

items.name: vintage-camera
items.text: a brassed vintage rangefinder on a worn leather strap, black paint rubbed to bare metal at the edges

items.name: umbrella-paper
items.text: an oil-paper umbrella tilted against the light, bamboo ribs printing spoke shadows across the face

items.name: mechanic-wrench
items.text: a heavy well-used wrench resting on the shoulder, chrome worn grey, the grip wrapped in oil-dark tape

items.name: violin-case
items.text: a scuffed violin case carried like a secret, travel stickers ghosted, one latch mended with wire

items.name: pocket-watch
items.text: a gold pocket watch open on its chain, guilloché dial and blued-steel hands, case back engraved smooth by pockets

items.name: flintlock-pistol
items.text: a flintlock pistol, figured walnut stock and engraved silver furniture, flint held tight in the cock's jaws

items.name: war-hammer
items.text: a rune-stamped war hammer, haft wrapped in oiled leather, striking face polished mirror-bright by battle

items.name: tarot-deck
items.text: a fan of gilt-edged tarot cards spread mid-shuffle, one card turning to catch the light

items.name: holo-projector
items.text: a palm-sized holo projector casting a flickering blue city into the air above it

items.name: potion-bandolier
items.text: a leather bandolier of stoppered potion vials, each glass glowing its own color, corks sealed in dripped wax, their mixed light ghosting up the wearer's jaw

items.name: cyberdeck
items.text: a scuffed homebuilt cyberdeck slung on a shoulder strap, ribbon cables and mismatched keycaps, a green phosphor readout lighting the fingertips

items.name: war-fan
items.text: a lacquered iron-ribbed war fan snapped open, gold-leaf ground behind a red sun motif, the reinforced edge catching light like a blade
